purpose: Teach: 伊丹/長岡/武藤/菊池/亀田/五十嵐/塚本/八田

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 伊丹部長の歓迎会を準備しましょう
lines.en: Let's set up the welcome reception for the new department head.
lines.style: Crisp, efficient. Light authority — this is the plan. Organized tone, no-nonsense pace. Warm enough that it lands as teamwork, not command.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。長岡課長の引き継ぎ書を確認します
lines.en: Got it. I'll review the handover notes from the previous manager.
lines.style: Quick acknowledgment with immediate follow-through. Steady, reliable. No hesitation — this is already underway in his mind.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 武藤技術主任のプロジェクト進捗を共有しましょう
lines.en: We should share the progress update on Mutoh's project.
lines.style: Clear directive, collaborative framing. Steady pace. Slight emphasis on 'we' — pulling him in, not telling him what to do.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。菊池広報の月次企画書を確認します
lines.en: Yes. I'll check Kikuchi's monthly planning report.
lines.style: Calm confirmation. Efficient rhythm — each task slots neatly. Professional but not stiff. Moving forward without fanfare.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 亀田顧問との面談を予定しましょう
lines.en: Let's schedule that consultation meeting with Kameda.
lines.style: Measured direction. Matter-of-fact but not cold. The tone of someone who has thought this through and is checking it off the list.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。五十嵐経理の決算予定を整えます
lines.en: Right. I'll get the fiscal closing schedule sorted with Igarashi in Accounting.
lines.style: Brisk agreement. Lean and efficient delivery. No wasted breath — he knows what needs doing and he's already on it.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 塚本人事に新人研修プランを依頼しましょう
lines.en: Let's ask Tsukamoto in HR to prepare the new hire training plan.
lines.style: Organized delegation. Light, clear — not demanding. The tone of someone coordinating moving parts with confidence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。八田法務に新契約レビューを依頼します
lines.en: Understood. I'll request the contract review from Legal.
lines.style: Final confirmation. Neat, decisive close. Professional and settled — the last piece clicking into place. Slight sense of satisfaction in the completion.
